title: zea mays var. autumnalis
intro: Zea mays var. autumnalis, commonly known as ornamental corn or Japanese corn, is a type of corn plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae) and is native to Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as improving digestion, reducing inflammation, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Zea mays var. autumnalis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents present in this plant have been found to exhibit potential in protecting against oxidative stress, cell damage, and certain diseases, highlighting its value as a natural therapeutic agent.
